description: Makes a new webhook signing secret for the API key making the call and returns it once. The old secret stops signing at once, so update your verifier right away. Works for sandbox and live keys. The same as POST /api/v1/key/webhook-secret.

api_key.description: Your Roster API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

name: rotate_webhook_secret
title: Rotate webhook secret
